name: hpc-tether
description: Audited access to an HPC cluster over an SSH ControlMaster: four user-set profiles (observe, prepare, operate, improvise; observe runs only the fixed tools), a payload guard that steers the agent away from common mistakes such as deletions and writes outside your write roots, an approval prompt for every write, read-only netCDF inspection, and a SLURM job monitor. Not a security boundary.
